name: a kagelet run that goes quiet is cut, retried once with the reason, and a second failure is one DM (#487)
why: A stuck run used to sit as a silent failed row until the owner looked hours later.

tasks.match: ^Retry: the last run went quiet for 20 min\. Do the job again, and end with a report\.\nRun now of job kagelet-digest

dms: ^Kagelet \*digest\* failed twice in a row, once on a retry: ended without a report\.
